notes: In the Google Play app, the Unlock Premium button sometimes did not appear when Google Play was slow to respond, often right after opening the app or on a weak connection. The app now tries again on its own, and again when you reconnect or come back to the app.
Opening a DebtFree link from another app, like Gmail or the Google app, could make the website act as if it were the Google Play app and hide the website upgrade option. That no longer happens.
